Two real bugs caught and fixed via direct inspection, both before relying on any automated check to catch them: (1) the copied render_page.py had the PREVIOUS chapter's title/chapter number ("Moving Charges and Magnetism", "Chapter 4") hardcoded as literal strings in two places (the page <title> and the s2/s3/s4 header block) instead of reading DATA["front"]["title"]/["chapter"] dynamically - fixed by introducing CHAPTER_TITLE/CHAPTER_NUM module-level variables read from the JSON and interpolating them in both places. (2) q_5.2/5.5/5.6/5.7's combined-at-item-level solution (each has 2 parts with empty solution_blocks of their own, per stage 8's own documented new shape) was being silently dropped entirely - render_item()'s parts-loop branch never fell back to the item-level solution_blocks/answer when no part actually carried its own solution, so these 4 items rendered their part prompts followed by nothing at all. Fixed by adding an any_part_has_solution check: render each part's own solution stack only when at least one part actually has one, otherwise render the item-level solution_blocks/answer as one combined stack after all the part prompts.
